claims.text: Everything below ``watermark_position`` is committed and recorded; this batch is not, and the watermark must not claim otherwise.
claims.why: The code breaks out of the loop without updating watermark_position or recording watermark when ingest is not available, thus leaving watermark_position at the start of the failed batch.

claims.text: Read from the index, not defaulted: a dry run reporting '0 projections' against an index holding thousands reads as a broken index rather than as an unasked question.
claims.why: The comment explains why projection_count is set to len(projected_hashes) in dry run, but the referenced behavior about index is not in this chunk.

observations.what: The variable 'projected_hashes' is used to track already-projected hashes and is updated only when batch_events are actually ingested (not in dry run). However, in dry run, the count of projected events is added to progress.projected but projected_hashes is not updated.

The 'hasher' is updated to 'pending_hasher' after processing each batch, which includes hashes of all entries in the batch (including malformed and blank ones). This may affect watermark hash consistency.

The 'watermark_position' is set to the last entry's end_offset after processing each batch, even if the batch had no events to ingest (e.g., all entries were already projected or blank). This means watermark advances even when no new events are projected.
